opportunities.point: A chemicals tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Management stated that all business units have strong sales pipelines and a positive sales growth outlook.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "All of these businesses are having strong sales pipelines and we see that the sales growth outlook looks positive across all these business units." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Chembond is experiencing significant growth in sealants and plans to consolidate its market presence through polysulfide and PU sealants.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Sealants, we are seeing a significant growth and we intend to consolidate our presence in that segment through our polysulfide and PU sealants." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Chembond is entering the new financial year with a strong order book for its chemicals business.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "So we are starting this financial year with a strong order book for our chemicals business also." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The water business achieved a 50% increase in volume during the second half.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "So 50% increase in terms of volume for our water business and most of this is carrying forward." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Promoter holding keeps climbing - the buying has not stopped.

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Public sector units represent about 30% of the water business and refused to accept force majeure until the government declared it.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "About 30 percent of our total business in the water business comes from public sector units, and none of them had accepted a force majeure until the government just declared it two weeks ago." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Public sector clients are refusing to amend contract terms during periods of cost increases.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Public sector is a different story. They are refusing to amend the terms. And for that, then our only hope is that the situation starts getting better." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Management described the period following the war declaration as very challenging.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "And post-war declaration, it was a very challenging period." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Mar, Jun) are still in the cycle.
